posts.author: espl
posts.text: Unless they start winning orders, the operating leverage wont be able to kick in. They have a high fixed cost base and hence, they need more and more revenue as their facilities are running at a very low efficiency. All good news related to compliances, no more capital expenditure for new facilities but just the missing part of jigsaw is more orders. I am also skeptical about the new loan, also I did not understand why they would raise 4000cr whereas their Indian debt is only around 1000-1200cr.
